Based on Amazon's reported net sales figures:
- FY2022 net sales: $513,983M
- FY2023 net sales: $574,785M
- FY2024 net sales: $637,959M

[DOC-1]

**Year-over-year growth calculations:**
- FY2022 → FY2023: ($574,785M − $513,983M) / $513,983M = $60,802M / $513,983M ≈ 11.83%
- FY2023 → FY2024: ($637,959M − $574,785M) / $574,785M = $63,174M / $574,785M ≈ 10.99%

These figures are directly comparable, as they come from the same consolidated statement of operations in Amazon's FY2024 10-K, with no indication of segment redefinition, divestiture, or fiscal-year mismatch [DOC-1].

The growth rate declined from approximately 11.83% (FY2022→FY2023) to approximately 10.99% (FY2023→FY2024), a modest deceleration of less than one percentage point.

ANSWER: Decelerate — YoY revenue growth slowed from ~11.83% (FY2023) to ~10.99% (FY2024)
